title: Domain of a Rational Function with a Quadratic Denominator
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Determine the natural domain of h(x)=1/(x^2-4) by finding every real x that must be excluded.

steps.title: Identify the Restriction Source
steps.explanation: The only danger is a zero denominator, so we require x^2-4 to be nonzero.
steps.why: Division by zero is undefined, while the numerator and polynomial are harmless.

steps.title: Factor the Denominator
steps.explanation: Recognize a difference of squares and factor it into linear pieces.
steps.why: A product equals zero exactly when one of its factors is zero.

steps.title: Solve for the Excluded Values
steps.explanation: Setting each factor to zero gives the two forbidden inputs x = 2 and x = -2.

steps.title: State the Domain
steps.explanation: All real numbers except -2 and 2 are allowed; the three open intervals cover them.
steps.why: Removing two points from the line splits it into exactly three intervals.
